description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a well-funded (Series A/B), stealth-stage consumer tech startup building an AI-powered map and social discovery platform. The product helps people figure out where to go and what to do — combining one of the largest structured indices of real-world places and events with a clever, social product experience.

As a Founding Engineer, you'll own problems end-to-end, work directly with founders, and make architectural decisions that shape the core system. This is a high-ownership, high-impact role for someone who thrives in ambiguity and moves fast.


WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Search and ranking at massive scale (200M+ places, millions of events)

 - Recommendations and personalization of places and events using embeddings, structured data, and social signals

 - Real-time infrastructure — chat, presence, and location systems that feel instantaneous

 - AI agent pipelines that plan, retrieve, and reason over diverse data sources

 - Map display algorithms that determine what deserves attention

 - Data pipelines that structure large volumes of unstructured web data for novel product experiences

 - Pushing Elasticsearch and vector search to sub-100ms latency across large datasets


ENGINEERING TRACKS

You don't need to fit neatly into one area — most people here won't.

Application Engineer (Full-Stack)

 - Build fast, expressive interfaces across mobile and web

 - Own features end-to-end from UI to backend

 - Tools: TypeScript, React, React Native, iOS/Android

Data / AI Engineer

 - Build the intelligence layer — search, ranking, pipelines, and agent systems

 - Design systems that operate over large-scale, messy real-world data

 - Tools: Python, TypeScript, Elasticsearch, Snowflake, LLMs, embeddings, retrieval and recommendation systems


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 0–5 years of professional software engineering experience

 - Proven experience building real-time or low-latency production systems

 - Proficiency in search, ranking algorithms, and related infrastructure

 - Experience with data processing pipelines, ML/AI workflows, or data engineering

 - Track record of infrastructure and performance optimization at scale

 - Prior experience at early-stage startups; comfortable operating with high ambiguity

 - Ability to own features end-to-end with cross-functional collaboration (product, design, engineering)

 - Strong problem-solving and fast decision-making in fast-paced environments

 - You care about how something feels, not just whether it works


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Salary: $150,000 – $250,000 USD annually

 - Equity as a founding team member


LOCATION

 - San Francisco, CA — on-site required

 - Candidates must be located in or willing to relocate to San Francisco

 - No visa sponsorship available — must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship
